contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTI[VS PF] AVG ; R/ [GLORIA EXERCIT]VS

Copper alloy coin. Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, if so, Trier mint, RIC volume 8 no. 84, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped, rosette diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI[VS PF] AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers facing each other with two standards…
